defectLedger.claim: Routing config and provider model metadata are safe when persisted rows omit fallbackProviderIds or supportedModels.
defectLedger.real evidence: Service/model/repository/fallback/hub paths now normalize fallbackProviderIds and supportedModels before .length/.includes/[0] access; isolated live-runtime proof shows /v1/model-routing and /v1/providers stay up against mutated legacy-shaped persisted data.
defectLedger.repro: Persist llm.routing.v1 without fallbackProviderIds or provider_profiles.config_json without supportedModels, then call getRoutingConfig()/setRoutingConfig()/resolveRoute().
defectLedger.root cause: Runtime assumed test-shaped arrays instead of normalizing partial persisted/input objects at the service boundary.
defectLedger.release impact: Closed in branch. Keep the isolated real-runtime proof and regression coverage in the release pack.
defectLedger.mock contamination: Yes - mock fixtures always populated arrays, which masked the crash path.

defectLedger.claim: release:verify and npm test represent ship-ready live evidence.
defectLedger.real evidence: package.json now routes release:verify through npm run release:proof:real, while repo-only verification stays in release:verify:repo.
defectLedger.repro: Inspect package.json and classify release:verify, release:verify:repo, npm test, and test:e2e:browser-mock-hub via scripts/quality/release-truth-lib.mjs.
defectLedger.root cause: Mock-heavy suites were allowed to stand in for runtime/browser/provider proof in release summaries.
defectLedger.release impact: Closed in branch. Keep repo-ready and real-proof lanes separate in docs, CI, and release notes.
defectLedger.mock contamination: No - release:verify no longer routes through mock lanes.

defectLedger.claim: README top-level messaging is evidence-driven and runtime-scoped.
defectLedger.real evidence: README uses Release Truth + runtime snapshot framing. Remaining risk is future drift if release notes and settings copy stop tracking live evidence.
defectLedger.repro: Compare README against package.json evidence taxonomy and live runtime snapshot.
defectLedger.root cause: Marketing-style copy drifted away from runtime evidence and env-gated reality.
defectLedger.release impact: Closed for this branch snapshot, but remains a process risk that needs continuous review.
defectLedger.mock contamination: Historical only - this branch no longer uses the 10,000+ proof claim.

defectLedger.root cause: Runtime truth already exposes unverified latestness, but release/UX messaging can still imply stronger guarantees than the runtime reports.
defectLedger.release impact: Needs explicit bounded wording until verified live search freshness exists.

defectLedger.mock contamination: No - this is a live runtime capability flag.

defectLedger.release impact: Closed for routed UI availability. Keep operator-only install and marketplace boundaries explicit in UI copy.
defectLedger.verification method: Route census plus live /v1/plugins response check

entries.reportSection: PR #132 / 自主引擎 SQLite 持久化
entries.claim: autonomous persistence 已被真实证明可跨重启恢复。
entries.realEvidence: Live isolated autonomous persistence proof observed a goal in planning state before kill, then recovered the same SQLite row as failed with failureReason="Interrupted by process restart" on next boot. Pending-goal rehydration is still unproven.
entries.verificationMethod: Live isolated engine + real /v1/agent/runs planner backend + restart against the same SQLite stateDir.
